newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Yabeng says major shareholder sells stake.
newsitem.headline: Yabeng says major shareholder sells stake.

text.p: Yabeng Investment Holding Company Ltd said on Thursday its major shareholder, South Africa's North West Development Corp, had sold its 40.2 percent stake to a consortium of black business groups.
It said the sale was subject to approval by the North West province government and a due diligence investigation by Bophirima Investment Holdings Ltd consortium.
Yabeng urged shareholders to exercise caution in their share dealings until a further announcement was made.
